paraphrase: What the yogins see, the Sāṃkhyas also reach; one who sees Sāṃkhya and Yoga as one is wise.

original.text: yad eva yogāḥ paśyanti sāṃkhyaṃ tad anugamyate / ekaṃ sāṃkhyaṃ ca yogaṃ ca yaḥ paśyati sa buddhimān
original.edition: as recited/printed; checked against the local e-text where noted
